map.一个商标能跨类保护吗？: Can a trademark be protected across classes?
map.商标按类保护，未在册类别不受该商标保护；重要品牌建议多类甚至全类注册防御。: Trademarks are protected per class, and classes not registered are unprotected; important brands should register across multiple or even all classes defensively.
map.分类选错有什么后果？: What are the consequences of choosing the wrong class?
map.选错类别可能导致核准的商品不含实际经营项，被他人在正确类别抢注近似商标，需重新申: A wrong class may mean the approved goods don't cover what you actually sell, letting others register a similar mark in the correct class—requiring a new application or opposition.
